description: the admitted methods compute what they say, counted in code points: `indexOf`/`lastIndexOf` give code-point positions or `not` (never -1, never half a pair); `replace` puts `$&` in literally; a pad fills to a code-point width, the last repeat cut on a code-point boundary.
rationale: Ruled S469 "more string methods admitted": "Each gets a typed signature counted in code points. `indexOf`/`lastIndexOf` return `int | not` (no -1). `replace`/`replaceAll` take plain strings only."
